QuickHacking Cyberware

QuickHacks target a user's Neuroport architecture.

A Neuroport acts as a NET Architecture containing Passwalls, Control Nodes and borrowed Black ICE.

Black ICE installed on an active Cyberdeck may be used by the Neuroport.

Netrunners are always considered Jacked Into their own Neuroport and may immediately respond to hostile intrusions.

A successful QuickHack causes the target to become aware that their Neuroport has been compromised unless the QuickHack specifically states otherwise.
